## Work history (chronological)

### MyFutureSelf — Co-founder & CTO (Jan 2025 – present)

Co-founded an AI iOS app that creates a personalized AI version of each user's future self from their own data, then delivers mentorship from that future self through a 90-day roadmap and a voice AI mentor.

As CTO, shipped iOS, backend, and AI systems end-to-end as the solo engineer.

**Metrics in first 5 months**:
- 22,700+ downloads
- 1,519+ paid subscribers (server-validated via Apple)
- $40,000+ in revenue
- 20,000+ hours of AI coaching delivered
- 4.7★ App Store rating from 636+ verified reviews

**Tech I personally built**:
- iOS: Swift, SwiftUI, Core Data, StoreKit
- Voice: WebRTC + OpenAI Realtime API
- Backend: Node.js on Firebase Cloud Functions, Firestore
- AI: OpenAI Responses API, Claude API
- Growth: Mixpanel analytics, Superwall paywall infrastructure

**Links**: https://myfutureselfapp.com — https://apps.apple.com/us/app/myfutureself-achieve-success/id6745573360

### Appointra — Co-founder (Jun 2024 – May 2025)

Co-founded a B2B lead-generation agency serving startups in San Francisco, New York, and Chicago. Wound it down in early 2025 to focus full-time on MyFutureSelf.

**Performance**:
- Scaled to **$20K MRR in 3 months**
- Generated **$2M+ in client pipeline value**
- Booked **hundreds of qualified meetings** for clients
- Replaced one client's SDR in weeks and 100x'd her output
- Closed a **unicorn-exit founder**, a **9-figure CEO**, and an **NYC AI startup serving Amazon, Google, and Apple** on the same model

**Infrastructure I personally engineered**:
- Bought hundreds of domains
- Configured thousands of email inboxes
- Full DNS / SPF / DKIM setup
- Automated warmup pipelines
- Tuned every detail (down to removing the website URL from email signatures) to clear Fortune 500 spam filters
- Built the AI-powered outbound system end-to-end

**The hack**: cold-emailed a senior at Miami University who'd just gotten press for his social media agency. Took him out for coffee, listened, found he needed cold outbound. Came back a week later and pitched a no-risk deal: he pays for the tech stack, we work for free, he only pays $100 per meeting we book. Used that performance to get warm intros to enterprise clients.

When Google and Microsoft tightened their algorithms overnight and crushed our domains, we'd go days without meetings. Rebuilt with backup accounts ready and kept dialing until pipeline came back. That became Appointra.

**Link**: https://appointra.net

### LeadBoost Pro — Co-founder (Mar 2023 – Jun 2024)

Started in my dorm room freshman year. Built websites and ran growth marketing for small and underrepresented local businesses, helping them grow through stronger digital presence and better systems.

**Performance**:
- Profitable from **month one**
- Generated **$20,000+ in revenue**
- Website retainers still generate ~$250 MRR in passive income today

**Link**: https://leadboost-pro.com

### Organic Roots Horticulture — Operations & Growth (May 2018 – Aug 2022)

Joined the family landscaping business at age 14 and worked through high school and into college. Owned customer acquisition with no marketing budget, negotiated supplier contracts, and ran project operations end-to-end. This is where I learned to run a business and developed the hands-on engineering instincts I still build with today.
